description.ja:
動き人を襲う、生きている水・聖霊水（ヒュドラ）。千年前の大戦ののち世界的な広がりを見せる砂漠化現象の中で、人間は水を得るためにヒュドラを狩っている。砂漠は全部で８つあり、さらに第９砂漠という幻の起源の砂漠が存在すると狩人・マオの父は息子に語っていた。

　姿を消した父を捜すため、マオは第９砂漠に向かい旅立つ…！


　　尊（みこと）に殺されたマオは、合成人形の頭の中で父親の幻である「遺物の力」と対話していた。
　そこで彼は、第９砂漠とは地球のことで、今マオたちがいる場所は月であると知る。


　遥か昔、ニアは初めて月に行った曾祖父の話を証明するために月へと降り立っていた。彼とほかの仲間たちは「月の石」を手にし、そこで彼らが願った結果、月面は地球そっくりに変わった。ニアは「遺物の力」に宿る意志となった今も、ひたすら地球である第９砂漠に帰ることを強く願っていたが叶っていない。


　マオは「遺物の力」から月の石の模造品をもらい、現世へと戻り敵視した物体をヒュドラと見なし凍て殺す能力をもち尊に反撃をする。そして尊も連れて第９砂漠へ行くと宣言して――…！

Konno Ao is a beautiful high school girl known as “The Prince”. Touyama Kouyou, a boy who used to tease her relentlessly back in elementary school, kept confessing his love to her.

“I dislike boys; I like girls.”

That was the reason Ao gave when she rejected him. But after that, the person who appears before her is… “Momiji”, Kouyou transformed into an exceedingly cute girl.

Carrying past guilt and current love, Momiji declares, “I’ll prove I can be the best girlfriend to you.”.

Even though it shouldn't, for some reason, Ao's heart begins to race. The curtain opens on a springtime-of-youth romcom full of mistakes.

過去の罪悪感も、今の恋心も抱えたまま、 「私があなたの最高の彼女になってみせます」と 告白するもみじ。

間違っているはずなのに、 青の胸はなぜか高鳴ってしまう。 間違いだらけの青春ラブコメ、開幕。

description.en: Chii and her husband are like any other happily married couple, except for one thing: Chii was assigned male at birth. Chii details her autobiographical account of growing up with gender dysphoria and ultimately deciding to transition in her early adult years. Shortly after Chii starts transitioning, she meets a man who is instantly enamored by her, and although he is surprised when Chii eventually tells him she used to live as a guy, he still wants to go out with her. As Chii continues to transition, her boyfriend supports her through the process, culminating in their marriage once her transition is complete.

Logo após ela começar sua transição, ela conhece um homem, que fica totalmente apaixonado por ela. Lógico que ele ficou surpreso quando Chii disse a ele que na verdade ela costumava viver como um homem. Mesmo assim, ele ainda queria sair com ela. Enquanto Chii continuava com a sua transição, ele sempre a apoiava durante o processo. E isso resultou no casamento dos dois!

biography.en:
Sōichirō Yamamoto (山本 崇一朗, Yamamoto Sōichirō, born May 31, 1986) is a Japanese manga artist. He is known for writing and illustrating [Teasing Master Takagi-san](https://mangadex.org/title/6e445564-d9a8-4862-bff1-f4d6be6dba2c/karakai-jouzu-no-takagi-san), [Fudatsuki no Kyōko-chan](https://mangadex.org/title/3ac9fd03-e3de-4520-90aa-d9fc002eac0a/fudatsuki-no-kyoko-chan), [In the Heart of Kunoichi Tsubaki](https://mangadex.org/title/1ab5f7e0-7768-457c-9f63-19471b6503cc/kunoichi-tsubaki-no-mune-no-uchi), and [When Will Ayumu Make His Move?](https://mangadex.org/title/425f2ccf-581f-42cf-aed3-c3312fcde926/soredemo-ayumu-wa-yosetekuru), all of which were ran simultaneously during their publication. 

Yamamoto was born and raised in the town of Tonoshō in Shōdoshima, an island part of Kagawa Prefecture. His hometown would later serve as the setting for Teasing Master Takagi-san.

He is a graduate of Kyoto Seika University Faculty of Art.

description.en: Nina had a rough start to life, stealing to survive—and eventually being sold into slavery by her own brother. But to her surprise, her captor, Prince Azure, ordained that she would live the life of a princess... specifically, that of the recently deceased princess-priestess, Alisha. But despite her changing fortune, Nina won't give up her old life without a fight... and Azure might just be the one to finally match her wits. But how much can she trust Azure? And can she stop the feelings budding in her heart, knowing she must eventually marry another...?
description.it: Nina è un'orfana che vive nei bassifondi della città con Colin e Saji, due fratelli orfani come lei. La ragazza si finge un maschio e si fa chiamare Ninaf per non essere venduta come schiava a causa del raro colore dei suoi occhi. Nina sopravvive rubando e cerca di prendersi cura dei due fratelli che vivono con lei, soprattutto di Colin che è gravemente malato. In seguito alla sua morte, Nina viene venduta da Saji e acquistata allo scopo di diventare la sostituta di una principessa morta che aveva lo stesso raro colore de suoi occhi. Nina ha tre mesi di tempo per imparare le buone maniere e lo stile di vite di una nobildonna, dato che il suo destino è sposare un principe di un altro paese.
description.ja: 星の神のごとき深き青――瑠璃色の瞳を持つ少女ニナは、その美しき瞳ゆえに、フォルトナ国第二王子、アズール・セス・フォルトナに見出される。三ヶ月後に、大国ガルガダの王位継承権を持つ第一王子のもとに嫁ぐはずだった姫巫女アリシャの身代わりとして。姫として作法を学び、美しく着飾り、大国を欺くことを求められたニナは、運命に翻弄されながら、一生に一度の恋に出会う。
description.pt-br:
Nina teve um começo de vida difícil, roubando para sobreviver — e eventualmente sendo vendida como escrava por seu próprio irmão. Mas para sua surpresa, seu captor, o Príncipe Azure, ordenou que ela vivesse a vida de uma princesa... especificamente, a da recém-falecida princesa-sacerdotisa, Alisha. Mas apesar de sua mudança de sorte, Nina não desistirá de sua antiga vida sem lutar... e Azure pode ser a única que finalmente corresponderá a sua inteligência. Mas o quanto ela pode confiar em Azure? E ela pode impedir os sentimentos que brotam em seu coração, sabendo que ela deve eventualmente se casar com outro...? [Kodansha]

description.es-la:
Oreimo: Kuroneko If es una historia alternativa dentro del universo de Ore no Imouto ga Konna ni Kawaii Wake ga Nai, en la que Kyousuke Kousaka no termina con su hermana Kirino, sino con Ruri Gokou, conocida como Kuroneko.

A lo largo de los cuatro volúmenes, se narra cómo Kyousuke y Ruri profundizan su relación durante un campamento de verano en una isla remota, donde conocen a una misteriosa chica llamada Haruka Makishima. Este encuentro desencadena una serie de eventos extraños que los llevan a enfrentar sus sentimientos, sus miedos y el destino que los une. La historia se desarrolla entre momentos de ternura, confesiones sinceras y decisiones importantes, culminando en una versión donde Kyousuke y Kuroneko se convierten en pareja y viven un verano inolvidable.

Esta ruta ofrece a los fans una conclusión emotiva y satisfactoria para el personaje de Ruri, dándole el protagonismo que muchos deseaban.

biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 伊藤潤二

**Birthdate:** July 31, 1963

Horror manga artist. Some of his most notable works include *Tomie*, a series chronicling an immortal girl who drives her stricken admirers to madness; Spiral Into Horror Uzumaki, a three-volume series about a town obsessed with spirals; and *Gyo*, a two-volume story where fish are controlled by a strain of sentient bacteria called "the death stench." His other works include *Itou Junji Kyoufu Manga Collection*, a collection of different short stories including a series of stories named *Souichi's Journal of Delights* and *Itou Junji's Cat Diary: Yon & Mu*, a self-parody about him and his wife living in a house with two cats. Itou's work has developed a substantial cult following, with some deeming him a significant figure in recent horror iconography.

In 2006, Junji married Ishiguro Ayako (石黒亜矢子), a picture book artist. As of 2013, they have two children.

description.es-la:
En el mundo devastado por la bruja Elena Mercurio, la humanidad se encuentra al borde de la extinción. Elena, con sus poderes y su lealtad al Rey Demonio, ha acorralado a los humanos, quienes preparan una estrategia desesperada para detenerla. Teletransportada al futuro, sin sus poderes y en un refugio humano, Elena debe adaptarse y sobrevivir sin revelar su verdadera identidad. En su nuevo entorno, conoce a Taro, un joven soñador que admira al "Héroe de la Creación" y anhela viajar para ayudar a los necesitados. Mientras Elena trama su venganza, Taro la introduce en la comunidad humana, mostrándole un lado de la humanidad que jamás había visto: hospitalidad, bondad y sueños de justicia. 

A pesar de sus intenciones de destrucción, Elena empieza a cuestionarse su misión al ver el impacto positivo de los humanos en su vida. El clímax llega cuando un dragón rojo ataca la aldea y Elena, usando la poca magia que le queda, se ve obligada a luchar junto a Taro para salvar a los aldeanos. Elena, ahora vista como una heroína por los aldeanos, enfrenta un dilema. Su odio hacia los humanos comienza a tambalearse, especialmente con Taro a su lado, quien desea acompañarla en su viaje. 

¿Podrá Elena continuar con su plan de venganza o se dejará influenciar por los valores de Taro y su sueño de un mundo mejor? Esta es la historia de una bruja poderosa y un joven idealista, unidos por el destino en un viaje que podría cambiar el futuro del mundo.

description.en:
The war of extinction "Titanomachy" ended with humanity completely destroying the demons and winning. Twenty-five years have passed since then. Alain, one of the seven heroes who subdued the Demon King Beelzebub in the war, is already 43 years old. As a knight captain on the frontier, he was spending peaceful days, sandwiched between inflexible lords and annoying subordinates.

But things change suddenly. The demon army that should have been destroyed suddenly revived and attacked. The subordinates were defeated in vain. The aristocrats just pushed the responsibility on others. So Alain stood up again. This time, in order to break the sword and connect to the next generation. In response to that, the former comrades gather again.

Set in the Edo period, a young swordswoman named Suzu travels to Edo seeking revenge for her father’s death. While staying at a roadside inn, she becomes caught up in a hostage-style terrorist incident carried out by a mysterious armed group calling themselves the “Tengu.”
She is rescued by “Mashira,” an all-female anti-Tengu unit. Among them is Tsuki, a warrior who cannot see, hear, or speak, yet overwhelms the Tengu with her extraordinary physical combat skills.

This is a hard-edged, unconventional period action story depicting the fierce clash between the eccentric warriors of Mashira and the Tengu.

O que salvou o dia foi uma unidade anti-Tengu composta inteiramente por mulheres chamada “Mashira”. Tsuki, um macaco guerreiro com deficiências nos olhos, ouvidos e boca, derrota o tengu com suas habilidades físicas impressionantes. 

Um filme de ação de época difícil e incomum que retrata a batalha entre “macacos” e “Tengu” que têm muitas peculiaridades!

description.en: Billionaire Tono Ryuichi, the President of Tono Foods Group, a giant food company, recently acquired two young female assassins from the Mexican cartel. Sui and Ai came from unimaginably poor childhoods and was given a choice between killing people or selling their body. They chose the former and went through an inconceivably extreme training and, at 17 years old, they have become one of the deadliest assassins in the world. They are absolutely obedient to their master and they are given the task of finding the killer that poisoned Ryuichi's wife and child. They begin attending high school to blend into society and, at the same time, read and study which helps them become even more deadlier on the field. Sui and Ai encounter Matoba Imari who is a high school assassin herself and may be more skilled than both of them. But unlike the two, Imari just wants to lead a normal life. Whatever Imari wishes for her life is not their problem because the only thing Sui and Ai feeds on are bloodthirst and a challenge.

description.vi: Tono Ryuichi, người đứng đầu Tono Foods Group, sở hữu trong tay một chuỗi các nhà hàng hạng sang đắt tiền tại Nhật Bản. Một ngày nọ, anh quyết định đến Mexico mua cho mình hai cô gái sát thủ trẻ được nuôi dưỡng bởi Mafia, với mục đích tìm cho ra kẻ đã hãm hại vợ và con của mình. Anh đặt tên cho cả hai là Sui (THÚY) và Ai (LAM). Sau khi chuyển đến Tokyo, Sui và Ai được Tono cho theo học tại một trường tư thục, nơi cả hai được thỏa thích đọc sách để nâng cao kiến thức để trau dồi thêm kỹ năng ám sát của mình. Tại đây, họ gặp được Matoba Imari, vốn cũng là sát thủ, thậm chí có phần còn giỏi hơn cả hai. Nhưng không giống họ, Imari chỉ muốn có một cuộc sống bình thường. Dẫu vậy, bất chấp mong muốn của Imari, những gì Sui và Ai quan tâm lại chỉ có mùi tanh của máu và những vụ săn giết thỏa mãn được bản tính ưa thách thức của họ.
